content: EcucChoiceContainerDef on the value side In the ECU Configuration Parameter Definition the container choices are specified as part of the EcucChoiceContainerDef . On the Value side a EcucChoiceContainerDef is treated as a usual container, though it depends on the upperMultiplicity of the EcucChoiceContainerDef how often the choice can be taken. Which choice has been taken is defined by the <DEFINITION-REF> of the <SUB-CONTAINER> .
